name: grid-forward-orient
title: Photo ring facing forward
description: A ring of cards on a tilted turntable, each turned to face the way it travels. The camera orbits and closes in during one slow stroke.

props.name: photos
props.doc: Photo file names inside public/photos, in order. Items take them in turn and repeat when there are more items than photos.

props.name: caption
props.doc: Small line at the bottom left. Empty for none.

props.name: showHud
props.doc: Show the caption and the counter.

props.name: aperture
props.doc: Depth of field: blur, in px, of a card one focus distance away from the focus plane. 0 keeps everything sharp.

props.name: drift
props.doc: Handheld drift on the camera, as a multiple of the default (about 0.4 degrees and 6 px). 0 for a locked-off camera.

props.name: radius
props.doc: Corner radius of the cards, px.

props.name: colors.ground
props.doc: Frame edge.

props.name: colors.ground2
props.doc: Frame centre, slightly lighter.

props.name: colors.ink
props.doc: Caption type.

props.name: colors.edge
props.doc: Hairline round every card, or 'none' (the default) for clean edges.

props.name: count
props.doc: Cards on the ring.

props.name: radius3d
props.doc: Radius of the ring, world px.

props.name: cardWidth
props.doc: Card width, world px. The long side runs along the direction of travel.

props.name: cardHeight
props.doc: Card height, world px.

props.name: tilt
props.doc: Degrees the plate tips away from the screen (0 faces us, 90 is edge on).

props.name: revolution
props.doc: Degrees the ring turns in the move.

props.name: direction
props.doc: Which way the ring turns.

props.name: orbit
props.doc: Degrees the camera orbits.

props.name: distance
props.doc: Eye distance of the wide shot after the crane.

props.name: chaseDistance
props.doc: Eye distance while riding with the first card.

props.name: motionBlur
props.doc: Camera motion blur shutter in frames, used while the camera moves fast. 0 turns it off.
